name: Tea, kelp
body:
Source Blood of the Sea pg. 19
Price 3 sp; Weight —
Category Food/Drink
Description
elp tea is a favorite relaxing drink under the sea, brewed from various rare species of kelp to create over a dozen distinctive flavors. The listed price pays for enough tea to fill a small waterproof bladder such as a sureseal bladder (Pathfinder Campaign Setting Aquatic Adventures 56) and doesn’t include the price of the bladder.
